text:
Omar (Revenue Ops): Heads-up: ACME-EAST disputed Invoice INV-2142. They claim burst charges were billed twice during a cross-zone failover on 2026-04-02.

Zoe (Acct Exec): Customer sent logs showing same job_ids in both dedicated and hosted usage. They're asking for an itemized refund not just a credit.

billing-bot: Dispute DIS-772 opened for INV-2142 on 2026-04-05. Status: investigating.

Hank (Billing): I pulled invoice lines: 
```
INV-2142-01,reserved_commit,1,$30,000
INV-2142-02,burst_charges,15000,$9,600
INV-2142-03,adjustments,1,$0
```

Sasha (Platform): We had a transient controller race in zone us-east-2a at 2026-04-02T04:12Z that triggered failover. The scheduler retried and marked instances active in hosted pool. Looks like lack of idempotency caused double-metering events. Raised INF-1259.

Omar (Revenue Ops): Customer is insistent on itemized refund. Do we have policy to refund burst amount or issue credit?

Hank (Billing): Policy: SLA credits go as invoice credits; refunds require exec approval for amounts > $5k. This burst is $9,600 so needs finance + revops sign-off.

Zoe (Acct Exec): Customer wants cash refund. They're an enterprise with reserved commit and good relationship. Recommend refund to preserve account. Need approval path.

Omar (Revenue Ops): I'll authorize provisional refund up to $10k pending infra reconciliation. Finance (Hank) — can you draft refund memo and route to FP&A for sign-off?

Hank (Billing): Drafting memo now. Will include job-level reconciliation sample and attach INF-1259. Will request expedited FP&A approval.

billing-bot: Created ticket BLG-930: "inv2142-acme-east-double-billing-refund".

Sasha (Platform): I'll attach deduped usage export to BLG-930 by EOD today. Note: some retries are legitimate and should remain billable.

Omar (Revenue Ops): Action items: 1) Sasha attach deduped export; 2) Hank draft refund memo and submit to FP&A; 3) Zoe prep customer note offering refund pending FP&A. Target: resolve by 2026-04-08.

Zoe (Acct Exec): I'll message ACME legal and Ops with conservative wording: "We found evidence of double-counting during a failover — we're expediting reconciliation and will follow up with a refund or credit after validation."

Hank (Billing): Noted. Holding collections for INV-2142 until FP&A signs off. If FP&A approves, we'll issue refund via payment team and post memo CM-452.

Omar (Revenue Ops): Thanks. Keep this thread updated when BLG-930 gets the deduped export.
